approval_boundary: Proposed settings. The user must approve this exact committed file hash and the exact batched run list before manual dispatch. An approval ID records that approval; it does not create it.

contract.vector_scope: D28 synthetic-only scan control; no inference, ANN execution or int8 recommendation

tier100.label: derived-100-repository fixture: 10 real source parts plus 90 correlated derived top-ups
tier100.review: Upload the manifest before timing. Lead review follows the run; a rejected manifest invalidates only tier100 results.

disk_admission: Free-space floor on RUNNER_TEMP before candidate timing, not a measured peak bound. Workspace and RUNNER_TEMP df logs are retained after every execution phase. A miss stops; nothing is deleted and no cap or venue changes automatically.
software_cleanup: Base/linkdelta only: on a disposable github-hosted Linux VM, remove exactly /usr/share/dotnet, /usr/local/lib/android, /opt/ghc and /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL. Preserve all workspace, RUNNER_TEMP, job evidence, Go/Python/Node tools and other tool-cache entries. Plan roughly 30 GiB free immediately after cleanup, before later caches and fixtures: an unverified 14 GiB starting-space assumption plus a historical 16.7 GiB Android/.NET reclaim. GHC/CodeQL savings are not credited. Actual image occupancy varies; df and the unchanged timing floors decide admission.

basis./venue/cpus: study/storage/checks/base/README.md Estimate and limits, study/storage/checks/vector/README.md Sizing estimates, and study/storage/checks/fixtures/FIXTURES.md name a four-vCPU Ubuntu host.
basis./venue/job_memory_bytes: Integration proposal: 12 GiB enclosing cap on the reports nominal 16-GB host, above the 10 GiB tier100 target cap with two GiB inside the job for controllers and cache. Delegation and outside-owner cleanup follow .github/workflows/storage-screen.yml. This is not engine RSS or a measured requirement.
basis./venue/host_reserve_bytes: Integration proposal: require at least 2 GiB physical memory outside the enclosing cap for the runner and cleanup owner. The reports name a nominal 16-GB host; actual MemTotal is checked.
basis./venue/price_cap_usd: Zero-cost public-fork standard Linux CI venue only. No paid runner, model inference, cloud job or extra service is requested.
basis./venue/max_parallel: Lead requested the active runner count. Serial job dependencies use one runner at a time and assume no additional parallel slot. Base uploads the tier100 freeze before any candidate timing in the batch.
basis./jobs/tests/timeout_minutes: Integration estimate: 45 minutes for setup, three readonly Go module vet/test pairs and two stdlib Python suites. This is not a measurement bound.
basis./jobs/base/timeout_minutes: Hard job envelope: (1500 setup + 600 fetch + 300 tiny generation + 1200 tier100 generation + 10800 measurement + 600 cleanup/upload) / 60 = 250 minutes.
basis./jobs/base/setup_seconds: Integration reserve: 25 minutes for Go setup, downloads, serial builds, metadata and manifest freezing outside timing; unmeasured. The fixed unused-software removal shares this setup reserve; budget roughly 1-3 minutes, not a measured bound.
basis./jobs/base/cleanup_upload_seconds: Integration reserve: 10 minutes for owned-root cleanup and evidence upload, outside target timing; unmeasured.
basis./jobs/linkdelta/timeout_minutes: Hard job envelope: (1200 setup + 600 fetch + 2 * 5400 serial measurement + 1200 cleanup/upload) / 60 = 230 minutes.
basis./jobs/linkdelta/setup_seconds: checks-link-delta proposal relayed by lead: build/cleanup about 20 minutes. This envelope reserves 20 minutes for setup/build separately; unmeasured. The fixed unused-software removal shares this setup reserve; budget roughly 1-3 minutes, not a measured bound.
basis./jobs/linkdelta/cleanup_upload_seconds: Integration reserve: 20 additional minutes for cleanup, two-tier evidence and upload; unmeasured.
basis./jobs/vector/timeout_minutes: Hard job envelope: (600 setup + 600 generation + 600 measurement + 600 cleanup/upload) / 60 = 40 minutes.
basis./jobs/vector/setup_seconds: Integration reserve: 10 minutes for Go setup, serial builds, metadata and freeze, outside query timing; unmeasured.
basis./jobs/vector/cleanup_upload_seconds: Integration reserve: 10 minutes for owned-root cleanup and evidence upload; unmeasured.
basis./fetch/wall_seconds: study/storage/checks/fixtures/FIXTURES.md proposes 600 seconds; expected download/decompression/hash time is 2-5 minutes.
basis./fetch/memory_limits_bytes/runner: Integration proposal: 256 MiB positive binding field only. The external fetch operation does not launch or measure a runner component.
basis./fetch/memory_limits_bytes/checker: Integration proposal: 256 MiB positive binding field only. The external fetch operation does not launch or measure a checker component.
basis./fetch/memory_limits_bytes/engine: study/storage/checks/fixtures/FIXTURES.md proposes 2147483648 bytes for the fetch process tree including charged file cache.
basis./tiny/wall_seconds: Integration proposal: five-minute generation deadline for checks/base/cmd/fixture, the source-free three-function tier documented in study/storage/checks/base/README.md.
basis./tiny/memory_limits_bytes/runner: Integration proposal: 256 MiB binding-only field; no runner component is launched by external tiny generation.
basis./tiny/memory_limits_bytes/checker: Integration proposal: 256 MiB binding-only field; no checker component is launched by external tiny generation.
basis./tiny/memory_limits_bytes/engine: Integration proposal: one-GiB generator cap, using the vector report generator budget as a conservative starting bound for the three-function fixture; not measured.
basis./tier100/wall_seconds: study/storage/checks/fixtures/FIXTURES.md proposes 1200 seconds; generation estimate is 2-10 minutes, not a Linux measurement.
basis./tier100/memory_limits_bytes/runner: Integration proposal: 256 MiB binding-only field; no runner component is launched by external tier100 generation.
basis./tier100/memory_limits_bytes/checker: Integration proposal: 256 MiB binding-only field; no checker component is launched by external tier100 generation.
basis./tier100/memory_limits_bytes/engine: study/storage/checks/fixtures/FIXTURES.md proposes 10737418240 bytes; estimated RSS 3-8 GiB is uncertain and excludes possible additional cache charge.
basis./tier100/repos: Approved scaling recipe in study/storage/checks/fixtures/FIXTURES.md: ten unchanged real parts followed by ninety correlated derived top-ups.
basis./tier100/seed: Approved existing cmd/gen recipe in study/storage/checks/fixtures/FIXTURES.md: seed 20261022, ordered ten-source input, synthetic cross-repository links disabled.
basis./base/wall_seconds: study/storage/checks/base/README.md proposed bound 10800 seconds and unmeasured 90-180-minute estimate including a possible bounded side-index branch.
basis./base/runs: study/storage/checks/base/README.md specifies three fresh measured processes per scaling point.
basis./base/safety_timeout_seconds: study/storage/checks/base/README.md proposed config sets the accepted runner safety timeout to 900 seconds.
basis./base/memory_limits_bytes/runner: study/storage/checks/base/README.md proposed config: 536870912 bytes; estimate below 512 MiB, not a measured peak.
basis./base/memory_limits_bytes/checker: study/storage/checks/base/README.md proposed config: 1073741824 bytes; estimate below one GiB, not a measured peak.
basis./base/memory_limits_bytes/engine: study/storage/checks/base/README.md proposed config: 4294967296 bytes; estimated engine RSS 1-3 GiB, with charged-cache uncertainty.
basis./linkdelta/wall_seconds: checks-link-delta proposal relayed by lead: 5400 seconds per unchanged tier, about 65 minutes expected, including the package-decomposition branch within the 90-minute deadline.
basis./linkdelta/memory_limits_bytes/runner: checks-link-delta proposal relayed by lead: 536870912 bytes per tier.
basis./linkdelta/memory_limits_bytes/checker: checks-link-delta proposal relayed by lead: 2147483648 bytes per tier.
basis./linkdelta/memory_limits_bytes/engine: checks-link-delta proposal relayed by lead: 8589934592 bytes per tier. This is never substituted for the link target cap.
basis./linkdelta/link_memory_limit_bytes: study/storage/checks/linkdelta/README.md and the approved check target: exactly 1610612736 bytes (1.5 GiB) for linking, independent of the engine cap.
basis./linkdelta/delta_sizes: checks-link-delta proposal relayed by lead: [1,2,4,8,16,32] physical chain checkpoints over alternating edits.
basis./linkdelta/query_repeats: checks-link-delta proposal relayed by lead: three measured repeats after one discarded warm-up; the warm-up is implemented by the entrypoint.
basis./vector/generate_wall_seconds: Integration proposal: 600-second generation bound, separate from the report 600-second measurement bound. The report estimates 3-8 minutes for the overall vector work.
basis./vector/generator_memory_limits_bytes/ru: Integration proposal: 256 MiB binding-only field; external generation launches no runner component.
basis./vector/generator_memory_limits_bytes/ch: Integration proposal: 256 MiB binding-only field; external generation launches no checker component.
basis./vector/generator_memory_limits_bytes/en: study/storage/checks/vector/README.md proposes a one-GiB generator cap for the synthetic NPY/JSONL fixture.
basis./vector/documents: D28 approved fixture and study/storage/checks/vector/README.md: 150000 documents.
basis./vector/queries: D28 approved fixture and study/storage/checks/vector/README.md: freeze 256 held-out queries before timing.
basis./vector/dimensions: D28 approved fixture and study/storage/checks/vector/README.md: 768 F32 components per vector; generator shape is fixed in source.
basis./vector/seed: D28 approved recipe and study/storage/checks/vector/README.md: seed 20261102 with the pinned generator source/build.
basis./vector/wall_seconds: study/storage/checks/vector/README.md proposes 600 seconds for the complete serial measurement/controller run.
basis./vector/memory_limits_bytes/runner: study/storage/checks/vector/README.md proposed run flags: 268435456 bytes for the small reducer.
basis./vector/memory_limits_bytes/checker: study/storage/checks/vector/README.md proposed run flags: 2147483648 bytes for each independent checker.
basis./vector/memory_limits_bytes/engine: study/storage/checks/vector/README.md proposed run flags: 2147483648 bytes for each scan engine.
basis./vector/workers: D28 allows at most four scan workers; study/storage/checks/vector/README.md proposed run uses four on the four-vCPU host.
basis./vector/k: study/storage/checks/vector/README.md proposed run flags: top k is 10.
basis./vector/candidates: study/storage/checks/vector/README.md proposed run flags: one global int8 candidate pool of 128 before original-F32 reranking.
basis./disk_min_free_bytes/base: Integration proposal: 24 GiB free, rounding up 24 times the 952570424-byte unchanged pair in study/storage/checks/fixtures/fixture-pins.json. Three fresh runs and up to four layouts retain many indexes; tier100, scratch and serving amplification remain uncertain. This is an admission floor, not a peak guarantee.
basis./disk_min_free_bytes/linkdelta: Integration proposal: 12 GiB free, rounding up 12 times the 952570424-byte unchanged pair in study/storage/checks/fixtures/fixture-pins.json for retained clean C bases, two delta forms/chains, validation memos and answer spools. Actual peak is unmeasured; no evidence is deleted.
basis./disk_min_free_bytes/vector: Integration proposal: 2 GiB free, rounding up four times the 460800000-byte F32 matrix for reference scratch, outputs and headroom. Actual fixture files and existing caches are already charged when the floor is checked.
basis./software_cleanup: Supported fixed-path cleanup, not a third-party action. The current actions/runner-images Ubuntu2404 software list confirms installed Android, .NET, Haskell and CodeQL toolsets. jlumbroso/free-disk-space README reports an older ubuntu-20.04.4 sample of 14 GiB Android and 2.7 GiB .NET reclaimed; its 31 GiB total also removes things this workflow preserves. Treat the 30 GiB planning figure as uncertain, not a current-host measurement. Sources: https://github.com/actions/runner-images/blob/main/images/ubuntu/Ubuntu2404-Readme.md and https://github.com/jlumbroso/free-disk-space#typical-output .
